referenceEvents.claim: Quad foreign ministers launched a critical minerals initiative to strengthen supply chains.
Quad leaders set out cooperation commitments covering technology and supply chains, distinct from verified project disbursements.

measurementProtocol.unitOfObservation: named project and legal financing instrument, not a summit announcement
comparability: Do not treat a signed memorandum or announced financing ceiling as cash transferred.
Do not add project financing commitments from multiple Quad partners when they finance the same project.
Keep USD and local-currency amounts separate until exchange-rate date and methodology are specified.
For India-specific outcome attribution, verify physical recovery/processing in India, not merely Quad participation.
missing: primary financing contract or official loan-disbursement statement for each named project
baseline supply-chain origin shares and plausible counterfactual
government cost and recipient benefit estimates

limitations: Official announcements document intent but not realized implementation.
No verified India-specific mineral recovery output is included in this batch.
No influence score or audit-gate promotion is justified.
